rounds: I would pay twice as much for a phone that lasts twice as long.
Repairing things is something for older people, not my generation.
Buying second-hand is just as good as buying new.
Design students care more about how things look than how long they last.
Companies, not customers, should pay for recycling their old products.
If something is cheap, nobody should expect it to last.
I would rather have one great pair of trainers than five cheap ones.
In ten years, repairing your own things will be normal again.
